bankNotes.breeganzo: 178 questions from Breeganzo (MIT), with option lengths rebalanced so length gives nothing away.

footer: Questions and reading material from Amey-Thakur/CLAUDE-CERTIFICATIONS, Breeganzo/CCDV-F-Preparation and NiravRVaghasiya/Claude-Developer-Foundations, all MIT licensed.
